prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1363; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on driver side by third-party vehicle entering from cross street. Police report requested. Claimant represented by counsel; all contact to go through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office. Confirmed representation and received signed authorization. Requested medical records and bills for reported lower back strain. Attorney indicated claimant was evaluated at urgent care and is following up with primary physician.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene photos and statements from both drivers. Both parties state they had a green signal, so liability is disputed. Witness contact information on police report noted for follow-up. Preliminary fault assessment pending witness interview.

Entry 4: Received medical records from urgent care. Diagnosis consistent with lumbar strain, no fracture noted on imaging. Physical therapy referral placed. Attorney's office requested a demand package once treatment concludes. Advised that no settlement discussions will occur until records are complete.

Entry 5: Followed up with attorney's office regarding outstanding physical therapy notes and wage documentation. Claim remains open under investigation. Reserve reviewed and maintained. Next review scheduled for when treatment status is updated.
